distance_scope: Matches actual GALAXY_RADIAL_SOURCE_REFERENCE_V001 DDO source registration, not a substitution of the independent distance central estimate
tracer_rule: In this restricted DDO atomic-gas-only member, assume fixed atomic-H tracer abundance: supplied HI emission weights = solved weights_m*rho_kg_m3/1.36; helium factor is constant and cancels from normalized means. No H2 or stellar density used. This is a declared optically-thin tracer/coordinate-path reference, not recovered sky-pixel weights.
observation_rule: Constant R along each vertical column, zero radial/vertical streaming, no beam; HI-weighted mean of R*Omega, then piecewise-linear interpolation of mean onto supplied12 radii without extrapolation; physical/released inclination once. Preserve full angular residual provenance.
replace_when: Same actual source member must be refreshed to convergence; full flow/observation sensitivity retained for calibration/predictions.

c2_geometry.note: Per-call copy; only the DDO154 geometry-dependent fields are re-derived (derive_geometry docstring).
